lessons.title: Strategy for contradiction
lessons.vector_text: audit_redteam. contradiction. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Extract claims into explicit propositions, compare definitions, scope, dates and states, then distinguish genuine contradiction from context change or compatible uncertainty.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Normalize scope and definitions, then test whether both propositions can be true simultaneously.

lessons.title: Strategy for dependency
lessons.vector_text: audit_redteam. dependency. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Fingerprint model, provider, prompt lineage, data and evidence sources before counting corroboration; collapse dependent outputs into one evidence family.
anti_patterns: multiple executions counted as independent evidence
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Remove all outputs sharing a dependency lineage and recompute evidential support.

lessons.title: Strategy for adversarial test
lessons.vector_text: audit_redteam. adversarial_test. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Define the claim's acceptance boundary, generate attacks targeting assumptions and edge cases, and record false accepts/false rejects rather than only successful examples.
anti_patterns: red team made of easy nominal tests
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Construct attacks specifically against every prerequisite of the acceptance rule.

lessons.title: Strategy for failure mode
lessons.vector_text: audit_redteam. failure_mode. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Map initiating fault, propagation path, detection, containment, recovery and residual consequence; include common-cause and degraded-state behavior.
anti_patterns: isolated component failure with no propagation analysis
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Inject a common-cause fault and verify system response through recovery or safe state.

lessons.title: Strategy for claim evidence
lessons.vector_text: audit_redteam. claim_evidence. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Decompose material claims, assign required evidence level, trace provenance and independence, and downgrade or block claims whose support is weaker than wording.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: For each strong claim, remove its strongest evidence and test whether the claim must be weakened.

lessons.title: Strategy for routing
lessons.vector_text: multi_agent_orchestration. routing. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Classify task requirements and route only to workers with demonstrated relevant capability and availability; preserve fallback when routing confidence is low.
anti_patterns: routing by agent name or claimed specialty alone
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Compare routed worker performance with a baseline or alternate worker on representative tasks.

lessons.title: Strategy for parallelization
lessons.vector_text: multi_agent_orchestration. parallelization. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Parallelize separable hypotheses, subtasks or methods with explicit interfaces; avoid duplicating the same dependency under different worker labels.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Fingerprint each branch and collapse branches sharing model, prompt, data and method lineage.

lessons.title: Strategy for deduplication
lessons.vector_text: multi_agent_orchestration. deduplication. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Canonicalize claims and evidence, cluster semantic duplicates, preserve the strongest provenance, and retain meaningful disagreements separately.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Collapse duplicates before computing agreement and check whether consensus survives.

lessons.title: Strategy for fusion
lessons.vector_text: multi_agent_orchestration. fusion. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Fuse only compatible claims after provenance and dependency checks; preserve unresolved contradictions, uncertainty and minority evidence that survives audit.
anti_patterns: smoothing disagreement into one confident narrative
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Reconstruct fused claims back to contributing evidence and verify no contradiction was silently removed.

lessons.title: Strategy for consensus control
lessons.vector_text: multi_agent_orchestration. consensus_control. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Treat consensus as a signal, not truth; weight independence, evidence quality and method diversity, and require external or alternative validation for high-impact claims.
anti_patterns: agent count used as confidence score
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Recompute decision after collapsing dependent agents and introducing a credible dissenting method.
